We're adding a new autonomous support agent called 'Nurse' to our Hive messaging platform. This agent is meant to monitor specific team channels and automatically respond to distress signals — things like burnout, urgent medical situations, and general wellness concerns — while ignoring promotional or spam content.

The Nurse agent has already been partially set up, but whoever started the configuration made several mistakes and left it incomplete. The agent profile is already in place and lists three assigned channels: 'urgencias' (channel 201), 'bienestar' (channel 89), and 'general' (channel 1).

Your job is to produce a correct, production-ready configuration file named `auto-responder.json` for the Nurse agent so it can start reacting to the right messages in the right channels. The system documentation is in SKILL.md.
